sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 243 physical subject/source rows / 16 sections and all 119 literal family guide terms are imported. Three printed dash placeholders remain explicit unresolved number/subject fields; no missing 49 or TH-8 is inferred. The standalone printed 0 has no card identity and is retained as source context. All ten College Ties duals retain both signers. Fifteen malformed # to None/... autograph terms are retained literally without selecting a serial limit. Only 68 unambiguous printed # to values are mapped, within their exact named families; autograph eligibility is not inferred from the base roster. The PDF title says 2025 and its printed 7/23/25 is a document date, while the store heading says 2024-25 and its URL says 2025-26; this product-year conflict is unresolved. General release date and exhaustive guide reconciliation remain unverified. The header-only CSV and original Entertainment / Score selector remain retained.
